name: kahuy
description: Atalhos para backend/ (API) e frontend/ (dashboard), cada um com o próprio package.json.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix backend run deploy && npm --prefix frontend run deploy
